summary: Read-only smoke test of imported WhatsFlow (fivezap) app. Backend: 49/49 pytest checks passed (health, login ok/wrong pw, 23 authenticated GETs return 200 JSON, 22 protected GETs return 401 without a token, public pay lookup). Frontend: admin login with Rithi0518@ redirects to the dashboard. All 12 sidebar pages render with an h1 and content, with no JS page errors and no API calls returning 4xx/5xx. The WhatsApp page shows state awaiting_qr with a QR image rendered. Public /teste form loads without login. /pay/227427597 (real painel customer) shows the renewal plans, and /pay/999999 shows a 'Link inválido' message. No real trials, payments, messages or system updates were triggered.
critical_code_review_comments: Observation (as-is behaviour): when the backend starts, background loops log in to painel.fun via 2Captcha Turnstile solving (each solve uses paid 2Captcha credit, balance $0.16) and sync to MongoDB Atlas. This is the original repo's design, not a defect of the import.
Dashboard 'Clientes ativos' shows 0 while the painel cache holds 13 users. This looks like original logic (the count comes from the local customers table, not the painel cache). Not changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_import_smoke.py for read-only regression checks. The other files in /app/backend/tests came from the repo and were not run. They may hit external services (painel.fun, InfinitePay, WhatsApp). Real painel customer id for /pay testing: 227427597.
